translations.web: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
translations.bsb: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
translations.kjv: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
translations.asv: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as ye see the day drawing nigh.
